text:
Maya: Dropped a prototype for the version-history scrubber + rollback flow. Key asks: keyboard scrubbing behavior (left/right, j/k), announcement cadence for screen readers, and confirmation modal copy. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC/version-scrubber (frame: Scrubber / Compact)
Jordan: Nice work. Implementation notes: use roving tabindex for scrubber stops, arrow keys for fine-grain, PageUp/PageDown for big jumps. When user scrubs with keyboard we should update an `aria-live=\"polite\"` region with 'Version 23 — deployed 2 days ago' but debounce updates to avoid flood.
Priya: Accessibility: agree on `aria-live` but debounce >=300ms. Also ensure the live updates are concise (no extras like 'button'). When opening snapshot diff modal, set role=\"dialog\", aria-labelledby to the title, and return focus to the scrubber after close. If scrubbing continuously, screen reader users need a way to pause updates (keyboard toggle or stop announcement).
Sam: Copy concern: current confirmation says 'Are you sure?' which is too vague for irreversible changes. Suggest copy variant A = \"Revert to Version {n}\" with supporting line \"This will replace the running deployment — undo available for 30 minutes.\" Variant B = \"Restore previous version\" with supporting line \"Traffic and config will revert. Confirm to proceed.\" We'll A/B these in canary and track `deploy.rollback.confirmed` with `label: copy_variant`.
Luca: Design idea: compact scrubber shows small thumbnails on hover; keyboard focus shows textual timeline with the version name and relative timestamp. For narrow screens collapse thumbnails into a single summary pill with \"v23 • 2d\". Also modal CTA contrast needs to be 4.5:1.
Maya: I'll add the copy variants into the modal frames and a narrow/mobile artboard. Also updated the interaction notes: show inline preview of changes (diff) and include a small \"Why revert?\" help link.
Priya: Extra a11y nit: ensure the scrubber stops are reachable by screen readers (use buttons with aria-pressed for selected) rather than bare divs. Also add `aria-describedby` for the 'undo window' text so users know the safety net.
Jordan: I'll implement roving tabindex + debounced aria-live (400ms) and ensure focus management for the dialog. Also will emit analytics when keyboard shortcuts are used: `deploy.scrub.key` event.
deploy-bot: Staging build with scrubber landed: https://staging.redwood.ai/deploys/scrubber-v1
Sam: Plan: Jordan builds this sprint, Luca polishes thumbnails and contrast, QA to validate keyboard + screen reader next week. We'll run the copy A/B in a small canary group.
Maya: Thanks—tagging Priya when figma updates are pushed for final a11y pass.
